# FopenBinaryUnsafeUsage

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Compatibility](/rules/#compatibility) · PhpStorm name: `FopenBinaryUnsafeUsageInspection`

The PHP manual recommends always opening files with the `b` (binary) flag
for portability; the `t` (text translation) flag is Windows-only and
mangles line endings. Also, `b` must come after the access letter (`rb`,
`wb+`, `r+b`) — a leading or middle `b` (`bw`) is wrong.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,8} [Before]
<?php
function open_files($path)
{
    $access = 'a';
    $h1 = fopen($path, $access);
    $h2 = fopen($path, "r+");
    $h3 = fopen($path, 'at');
    $h4 = \fopen($path, 'bx');
    $h5 = fopen($path, 'r+b');
    $h6 = fopen($path, 'xtb');
    $h7 = fopen($path, '');
    $h8 = fopen($path);
    $h9 = fopen($path, $_GET['m']);
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function open_files($path)
{
    $access = 'ab';
    $h1 = fopen($path, $access);
    $h2 = fopen($path, 'rb+');
    $h3 = fopen($path, 'ab');
    $h4 = \fopen($path, 'xb');
    $h5 = fopen($path, 'r+b');
    $h6 = fopen($path, 'xtb');
    $h7 = fopen($path, '');
    $h8 = fopen($path);
    $h9 = fopen($path, $_GET['m']);
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Add the &#39;b&#39; flag to the mode for binary-safe file access.</li>
<li>line 6: Add the &#39;b&#39; flag to the mode for binary-safe file access.</li>
<li>line 7: Use the &#39;b&#39; flag instead of &#39;t&#39; for binary-safe file access.</li>
<li>line 8: Move the &#39;b&#39; flag to the end of the mode (e.g. &#39;rb&#39;, &#39;rb+&#39;).</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ENFORCE_BINARY_MODIFIER_USAGE` | bool | `true` | When on, modes lacking `b` (with or without `t`) are reported; when off only misplaced `b` is reported. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "FopenBinaryUnsafeUsage": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "ENFORCE_BINARY_MODIFIER_USAGE": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore FopenBinaryUnsafeUsage

/**
 * @noinspection FopenBinaryUnsafeUsageInspection
 */
```
